title: Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract: Payment Processing Terms
content:
**Payment terms — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

These figures govern how payments on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract are received, priced and applied. They are the same on every tier, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 through Tier 1+.

| Term | All tiers (Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1, Tier 1+) |
|---|---|
| Payment cutoff time (Central Time) on a business day | 20:00 |
| Order in which a payment is applied | accrued interest, then principal, then fees due |
| Days in the year for daily simple interest | 365 |
| Debit card payments accepted per calendar month | 2 |
| Largest single debit card payment | $2000.00 |

### Convenience fee by payment channel (collected on top of the payment)

| Channel | Fee, all tiers |
|---|---|
| Online bank transfer (ACH) | $0.00 |
| Autopay bank draft (ACH) | $0.00 |
| Automated phone line, bank draft | $0.00 |
| Phone agent, bank draft | $0.00 |
| Phone agent, debit card | $5.95 |
| Mailed check | $0.00 |
| Cashier's check | $0.00 |
| Wire | $0.00 |
| MoneyGram | $0.00 |

### Notes on the figures

- The cutoff time is the time of day by which a payment must be received on a business day to post that day.
- Daily simple interest uses a 365-day year on every tier: the daily interest is the yearly interest divided by 365.
- The phone-agent debit card channel is the only channel that carries a convenience fee; every other channel is free.
- A convenience fee is collected on top of the payment and is never part of the amount applied to the contract.
